direct_measurements_distinguished_from_m.native_extract_route: Fresh FastPrep cell-free extracts assayed spectrophotometrically using NAD(P)H-linked reactions. GAPDH affinity was remeasured by substrate titration; most other recipes are fixed-input capacity assays.
direct_measurements_distinguished_from_m.native_whole_cell_route: Zero-trans influx of carbon-14-labelled glucose measured in a 5-second uptake assay over experimentally set glucose concentrations.
excluded: ODE/model-predicted intracellular fluxes or metabolite concentrations
Source optimization of an allosteric model or rate equations treated as measurements
direct_measurements_distinguished_from_m.claim_boundary: Collective extract or native-cell capacity/uptake is a possible empirical observable. Neither route isolates an individual Tdh/Hxk/Hxt isoform's intrinsic turnover. These alternatives require an exact new target decision before raw response access.

biological_preparation.growth: Aerobic glucose-limited chemostat in defined mineral medium; glucose is the growth-limiting nutrient
biological_preparation.starvation_conditions: Non-starved versus 4-hour nitrogen-starved cells derived from each corresponding chemostat history; starvation medium lacks ammonium sulfate and contains excess glucose.
biological_preparation.isoenzyme_assignment: Not established. GAPDH is an aggregate extract activity; distinct Tdh isoforms cannot be assigned from the coupled reaction alone.

input_conditions_verified.pH_status: Exact pH not specified in the inspected main-text assay section or Text S1; retrieve the referenced standardized protocol before use.
input_conditions_verified.buffer_qualification: Source first describes sulphate as 5-10 mM, then gives 2.5-10 mM depending on MgSO4/coenzyme additions. Preserve assay-specific amounts; do not silently reconcile the two descriptions. ATP, ADP, NADP and TPP binding was included in total magnesium additions.

gapdh_forward_recipe.qualification: This is the fixed-input recipe. Text S1 separately says GAPDH affinity for NAD was redetermined by varying substrate concentrations; the actual titration grid is not given.

pyruvate_kinase_recipe.qualification: Fixed FBP is an assay input, not evidence for an independently varied FBP response.

input_conditions_verified.allocation_randomization: Not reported in the inspected methods

inventory_counts_and_hierarchy.source_says: From each of four cultures cells were harvested for fermentative capacity/metabolites, extract activities and glucose-transport kinetics.
inventory_counts_and_hierarchy.interpretation: Four named conditions are not four verified independent biological replicates. Starved cells are derived from their original chemostat cultures; paired history/sample ancestry must be retained. Multiple substrate levels or assay recipes do not increase biological N.

raw_data_status.published_tables_not_substitutes: Tables S1-S3 are parameters/initial conditions; S4-S5 parameter/capacity summaries; S6-S16 include model/prediction/regulation quantities. Their publication does not establish available raw titrations.

source_modeling_and_normalization_histor.uptake_fit: Irreversible Michaelis-Menten without product inhibition, nonlinear regression
source_modeling_and_normalization_histor.extract_reduction: Reported Vmax/affinity values reduce detector assays to parameters. Such values can support appropriately scoped parameter checks, not distinguish alternative functional forms without the underlying rates.

unit_adapter_as_reported.qualification: This is an assumed cell-volume conversion for model representation, not an independently measured active-enzyme denominator. Raw source units/calibration must be recovered; do not infer intrinsic kcat.

source_modeling_and_normalization_histor.model_selection_exposure: The paper reports condition-specific model/parameter choices and compares to earlier physiological observations. Those observations and source-template parameters cannot automatically be called a new blind test.

earlier_sample_and_data_sources.title: Time-dependent regulation analysis dissects shifts between metabolic and gene-expression regulation during nitrogen starvation in baker's yeast
Time-dependent regulation of yeast glycolysis upon nitrogen starvation depends on cell history

source_modeling_and_normalization_histor.ancestry_rule: The source explicitly distinguishes reused flux/metabolite data and earlier optimized-activity assays from new in-vivo-like assays on the same samples. Treat remeasurement as a new channel, not a new biological sample; audit previous paper/parameter exposure before reserving labels.

candidate_support_leads: Direct tracer uptake as a different physical measurement from extract absorbance
Previously measured fermentative capacity and metabolites in related samples
orthogonal_support_and_reservation.warning: These channels measure different observables and may share cultures. They are not automatically orthogonal validation of a specific Tdh/Cdc19/Hxk reaction law. A cross-assay model, matched context, ancestry and error covariance would be required.
orthogonal_support_and_reservation.possible_labels_after_inventory_and_regi: Complete unexposed parent-culture/preparation units with all derived starvation samples and channels; within-preparation randomized assay units only under an explicitly registered conditional claim and actual allocation evidence.

decision: Useful direct native physiology/extract-capacity lead with real controlled substrate assays. Raw records, biological ancestry, amount/units, randomization and matched validation remain blocking; published constants and modelled fluxes must not be fitted as raw reaction truth.
